newsitem.title: INDIA: Mild tremor jolts Indian capital.
newsitem.headline: Mild tremor jolts Indian capital.

text.p: A mild tremor shook the Indian capital on Wednesday and authorities said it did not appear to be a major tremor.
"There has been a local earthquake but it does not seem to be dangerous," R.C. Saxena, director of the Seismological Division of the Meteorological Department, told Reuters by telephone.

Saxena said officials were trying to determine the intensity of the tremor, which he said appeared to be centred in the New Delhi region. The Royal Observatory in Hong Kong said it had recorded no earthquake on its seismographs.
The New Delhi police control room said it had received no reports of damage or injuries.
The brief tremor was felt in the capital at about 1:10 p.m. (0740 GMT).
In September 1993, an earthquake measuring 6.3 on the Richter scale struck the western state of Maharashtra, killing an estimated 10,000 people.
